Facts:
- Giuseppe Verdi composed the three-act opera "Luisa Miller" to an Italian libretto by Salvadore Cammarano.
- "Luisa Miller" is based on Friedrich von Schiller's play "Kabale und Liebe" ("Intrigue and Love").
- Jules Massenet composed the five-act opera "Don Quichotte" to a French libretto by Henri Caïn.
- Loretta Di Franco performed many roles at the Metropolitan Opera, including Laura in "Luisa Miller" and the title role in "Lucia di Lammermoor."
- Loretta Di Franco also performed Annina in "La traviata," Frasquita in "Carmen," Musetta in "La bohème," Oscar in "Un ballo in maschera," and Zerlina in "Don Giovanni" at the Metropolitan Opera.
- Loretta Di Franco additionally appeared at the Metropolitan Opera as Barbarina and Marcellina in "The Marriage of Figaro," Berta in "The Barber of Seville," Ines in "Il trovatore," Kate Pinkerton in "Madama Butterfly," and Woglinde in both "Das Rheingold" and "Götterdämmerung."
